narration.en: Every student of Section A is a student of the college. The section is a subset of the college.
narration.kn: ವಿಭಾಗ A ಯ ಪ್ರತಿಯೊಬ್ಬ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿಯೂ ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ವಿದ್ಯಾರ್ಥಿ. ಆದ್ದರಿಂದ ಆ ವಿಭಾಗವು ಕಾಲೇಜಿನ ಉಪಗಣ.

body.en: $A$ is a subset of $B$, $A \subset B$, if every element of $A$ is also in $B$. Every set is a subset of itself, and $\phi$ is a subset of every set. $A = B$ exactly when $A \subset B$ and $B \subset A$. If $A \subset B$ and $A \ne B$, $A$ is a proper subset. A set with $n$ elements has $2^n$ subsets (exam note: the set of all of them is the power set $P(A)$).
body.kn: A ಯ ಪ್ರತಿ ಅಂಶವೂ B ಯಲ್ಲಿದ್ದರೆ A ಯು B ಯ ಉಪಗಣ. ಶೂನ್ಯ ಗಣವು ಪ್ರತಿ ಗಣದ ಉಪಗಣ. n ಅಂಶಗಳ ಗಣಕ್ಕೆ 2ⁿ ಉಪಗಣಗಳಿವೆ.

body.en: For real $a < b$: open interval $(a, b) = \{x : a < x < b\}$, closed interval $[a, b] = \{x : a \le x \le b\}$, and half-open $[a, b)$ and $(a, b]$. A round bracket leaves the end point out; a square bracket takes it in. The length of each is $b - a$.
